summary: S1 closed — nav labels now appear verbatim in the heading they land on (Commitments / Evidence). No structural defects remain at this page size.

findings.finding: Information scent breaks at the nav. 'Method' lands on a section headed 'Three commitments'; 'Evidence' lands on 'What a review produces'. Only 'Engage' matches. A reader who clicks a label and arrives at a different word has to re-orient before reading.
findings.repair: Make the label and the heading the same words, in the heading's favour: nav reads Commitments / What a review produces (or shorten the heading to Evidence). Acceptance: every nav label appears verbatim in the h2 of its target.

findings.finding: Heading order is sound (single h1, h2 per section, h3 within cards), the skip link is first in tab order, and landmarks are present. No progressive-disclosure or grouping defects at this page size.
